intro: The Zhevra is an early hunting trial issued by Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. As part of a progressing test of martial prowess across the savannas of the Barrens, young hunters are charged with tracking down swift zhevra runners and taking their powerful hooves.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders. Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.
Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves. Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How many zhevra have you slain?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Not bad, friend. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!
It looks like you have some strength in you too. Are you ready for a real challenge?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
